description: This file contains implementation of JSON-related classes and functions within the WPEFramework Core JSON namespace, including error message formatting, debug string generation for variants, and static member definitions.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error with message, context, and position information.

classes.name: IElement
classes.description: Interface or class related to JSON elements, with a static NullTag.

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Represents a JSON variant that can hold different types and provides debug string output.

classes.name: VariantContainer
classes.description: Container for multiple Variants, providing debug string output.

methods.name: ErrorDisplayMessage
methods.description: Formats an error message with optional context and position.

methods.name: Variant::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a formatted debug string representing the Variant's contents.

methods.name: VariantContainer::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a concatenated debug string of all Variants in the container.
